glass: large V-shaped cocktail glass (about 250 ml), chilled, no ice
version: v1 (round 3, 2026-10-01): a Martini with more vermouth than gin, the kind on Gin Palace's first list (Proper p. 141; no ratio on the page, so the ratio is mine), on Noilly Prat (Briars's 'more than a dropper', p. 142) with orange bitters (his other first, p. 142). Spark: a measure of Tokaji Aszú for the Budapest of Chalker's brief (p. 141); Tokaji is in none of our books, so its values and its Hungarian origin are my own knowledge, marked unsourced. Style 'stirred' is run for Arnold's dilution physics; a wine core reads OUT on strength, sugar and acid by structure, benchmarked against the Codex's Bamboo (p. 91), as Night Light did.

accepted.why: a wine-core Martini, more vermouth than gin, with Tokaji: lighter and sharper by design (D2)
